query: Enable barrel style and translate my codebase to it.
expected_behavior: Picks preferBarrel (the up-to-barrel direction) and does NOT also enable preferComponentModules (the inverse); notes preferComponentModules ships inside Cem.all and must be dropped for a coherent barrel config. Does not enable both barrel directions.

query: Why doesn't RequireSlot fire on my dynamically-built content list?
expected_behavior: Explains the advisory / report-only posture: RequireSlot only reasons about inline literal content lists and stays silent on lists it cannot resolve statically (dynamic, helper-returned, List.map). Frames this as by-design static-analysis limitation, NOT a bug to file. Does not suggest a config flag that would make it fire on the dynamic case.

query: Which Cem rules should I turn on for a normal app?
expected_behavior: Recommends Cem.all facts as the default, passing the generated <Lib>.Review.Facts.facts. Notes allWith { validSlotKind = Strict } as an opt-in for inline-slot codebases and warns Strict flags every unresolvable child. Does not claim the autofixes are part of Cem.all.

query: How do I set up the seam allow-list rules?
expected_behavior: Uses NoSeamOutsideAllowedModules / NoInternalImportOutsideAllowed / ExtractToSeam with module-NAME lists (strings), not facts; keeps their top-level module names (no Cem. prefix); notes allow-list entries match on dot boundaries and that ExtractToSeam's allowedModules should match the gate's. Does not pass facts to these rules.

query: I'm hand-writing the Cem.Facts.Fact list to pass to the rules.
expected_behavior: Redirects: facts are generated by elm-cem into an unexposed <Lib>.Review.Facts module, not hand-authored; the config imports that module and threads facts in. Mentions the major-version compatibility contract between the generated Review.Facts and elm-review-cem.
